{"consolidated_memory":"**Message redelivery issues in worker/queue/consumer.py (background jobs)**

File: worker/queue/consumer.py
Test coverage: tests/worker/test_consumer.py
Stack: Python
Symptom across all occasions: same message id handled more than once
Repro pattern: kill the worker mid-batch and restart it

---

**Occasion 1: [2026-04-13]**
- Context: General message redelivery, manifested after client had already retried once
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #5373, branch fix/message-redelivery-1
- Measured outcome: flaky test went from 29 failures per 100 runs to zero

**Occasion 2: [2026-04-20]**
- Context: Only affected sessions arriving through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #6383, branch fix/message-redelivery-2
- Measured outcome: memory settled at 357 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB

**Occasion 3: [2026-06-16]**
- Context: Only affected jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #6942, branch fix/message-redelivery-3
- Measured outcome: reclaimed 52 GB of blob storage"}
